About this report

Simulated analytics case study

Project: Olist Delivery Performance & Customer Satisfaction analysis

Data source: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist (Kaggle). 99,441 orders from 2016–2018 across 27 Brazilian states.

Analysis window: January 2017 – August 2018. Early ramp-up months and the ragged tail excluded to avoid noise.

Universe: 96,476 delivered orders with a valid delivery timestamp.

Key metrics: On-time rate compares actual delivery date to the estimated delivery date recorded at checkout. Review scores are customer ratings from 1 to 5 stars.

Data quality: 1,128 duplicate reviews resolved; 1,359 timestamp anomalies flagged; 71 migration artifacts flagged. 610 missing product categories labelled as unknown_category. No rows deleted without a documented rule.

Disclaimer: This is a simulated portfolio case study. No real client engagement. All figures are derived from public data.
